params.prompt: Macro cinematography, photorealistic: warm off-white paper documents with visible fiber texture drift slowly through a dark charcoal-blue studio void, soft directional studio light, shallow depth of field. A thin MATTE deep-teal ribbon of light, dark desaturated teal like ocean depth, traces slowly between the floating sheets, gently connects them, and calmly underlines one sheet that tilts toward camera; a soft warm amber glint appears at one corner of that sheet, then settles. Strictly forbidden: letters, words, numbers, typography, icons, symbols, user interface, screens, charts, diagrams, logos, people, hands. Strictly forbidden: neon, cyan, bright glow, bloom, lens flares. Muted palette only: charcoal near-black, warm paper white, deep desaturated teal, faint warm wheat. Slow controlled dolly drift, premium restrained financial atmosphere, seamless loop, silent.
